method.allowed_sources: Only existing publicUSGS landmark points/evidence and their original cached public node/hierarchy receipts; no new requests, private canopy, BOOMS or restricted data.
method.ground: Nearest class2 point within3m in XY; height difference is a diagnostic local reference, not tree height or terrain interpolation.
method.exclusion: Exclude class1 elevated points within2m of any class6 building return; this is a conservative screening distance, not a roof-footprint or canopy boundary.
method.clusters: 8-connected occupied1m grid, minimum5cells; reported centroids are return-cluster centroids, never tree trunks. Thresholds are diagnostic choices, not forestry accuracy criteria.

findings: Both cached clouds contain class1(unclassified),2(ground),6(building),7(noise), with ZERO class3/4/5 vegetation-classified returns. Class1 must not be relabelled vegetation.

Acquisition helper clips returns to each selected parcel polygon before saving. These two clouds do not establish full adjacent street/right-of-way coverage; bounding boxes include unsampled gaps and are not coverage polygons.
OCPA footprint query returned0 for both parcels; class6 point exclusion cannot eliminate roof overhangs, unclassified building surfaces, equipment, wires or all wall returns.
Nearest ground references vary spatially; a parcel-median subtraction alone is unsuitable for canopy height. Local flight dates/leaf state and changes since2018-2019 remain unknown.

Current illustrative tree arrays were deliberately not queried under this source-only scope. Existing tree overlap/de-duplication is UNASSESSED, not zero. Candidate centroid matching would not establish trunk identity.
promotion_gates: Vegetation interpretation of original class1 clusters with roof/equipment exclusions and dated public aerial/reference corroboration.
Explicit candidate/source coverage polygons and street/right-of-way coverage before any full-corridor placement claim.
Separate observed crown envelope from inferred trunk; evaluate existing illustrative-tree collisions/duplicate positions in an authorized scene comparison.

crs_limits: Original EPT metadata retained here; acquisition helper converts EPSG3857 XY toEPSG32617 without modifying Z. Source receipt declares NAVD88meters. NPZ itself has no independent CRS header; no vertical reprojection or geoid/current survey accuracy claimed.
